_comment: What a skill needs to work on a machine. Copy to requires.json (not tracked by git) and list your own skills. Read by `myskill unusable` (which skills cannot work here) and `myskill probe` (suggestions for this file). env: every one must be set; env_any: at least one; bin: on PATH; mcp: a server in ~/.claude/mcp.json; note: a condition no program can check, shown for a person to judge. An empty entry {} means: checked, needs nothing here — probe skips it.

cloud-review.note: useful only for Azure and GCP projects
